description: Displayed at the Algerian army territorial information centre named for Chahid Mohamed Boubarnasse. Wrecks and Relics Online refreshed this site on 1 January 2026 making it the most current Algerian display record found. A second small aircraft at the same site is unresolved between a Zlin Z-43 and a Saab Safir and is left out of this list.
museum_name: Centre d Information Territorial Chahid Mohamed Boubarnasse
